title: Sudarshana Jheel (Junagadh)
hook: Sudarshana Jheel (Junagadh): Pushyagupta (Chandragupta ka rajyapal) ne banwayi.
exam_points: Tushaspa (Ashoka ka rajyapal) ne nahar nikali; Rudradaman ne marammat ki.
Skandagupta ke rajyapal ke putra Chakrapalita ne marammat ki.

mcqs.q: Sudarshana jheel ka sambandh kis Maurya raja ke rajyapal Pushyagupta se hai?
